content: Hello! how can I help today?
My Medicare premiums jumped after a one-time income spike. Can I fix it?

Yes—file **SSA-44** to appeal **IRMAA** using a **life-changing event** (work stoppage, reduced income, divorce, etc.). Provide proof of the event and your **current-year** lower MAGI projection to reduce the surcharge.

1) Complete **Form SSA-44** with the qualifying event date.
2) Attach supporting docs (termination letter, pay stubs, settlement, etc.).
3) Submit to SSA; keep a copy and receipt.
4) Reconcile your **AGI planning**—Roth conversions, RMDs, and capital gains can push IRMAA back up.
Lower IRMAA is not a tax credit, but you should **sequence** income events (QCDs, Roth conversions) to keep MAGI within brackets. Store the SSA determination with your tax workpapers.
Do I need to re-file next year?
If income changes again, yes—IRMAA recalculates annually. Calendar your **SSA-44** timing to align with expected MAGI shifts.
